thread:
Rae: Helios Systems POC: Go SDK streaming + function-calls failing with their edge proxy. Also asked for quantization recommendation for 8-bit on cpu fallback and a short FedRAMP-ish security checklist.
Omar: Go SDK supports streaming over websocket + SSE. Function-calls are GA in recent builds; ask which SDK version. If older, proxy translate is fastest.
Rae: They're on 0.8.x pinned.
Leila: 0.8.x predates function-call GA. Fast workaround: run translator at edge to convert frame types -> local HTTP webhook. No code change in their app.
Leila: Minimal proxy config snippet:
```
proxy:
  mode: sse
  forward_toolcalls: true
  webhook: http://localhost:8081/tools
```
Omar: Quantization recs: for CPU failover, 8-bit quant (q4_0/q8_0) is reasonable but depends on model. Recommend we provide a small bench script and two quant options (int8/qlora-ish) for them to try.
Rae: Procurement wants hosted vs 12mo Dedicated comparison for 30 RPS @ 900 tokens/req. Include assumptions + TCO ranges.
Leila: Security checklist (FedRAMP-style): KMS integration, tenant isolation, audit logs export, VPC peering, short-lived creds, cert pinning, and evidence matrix. We'll surface what needs legal.
ops-bot: Created ticket HS-2100 for proxy handoff + bench scripts (assignee: Leila).
Omar: Action items: Leila = proxy + bench scripts + sample payloads; Rae = one-pager pricing draft; I'll capture quantization scenarios. Target delivery: EOD tomorrow.
Rae: Thanks team, I'll coordinate the call with Helios infra after artifacts land.
